RPGTB.Address.Name: RPG Tools address
RPGTB.Address.Hint: The bridge address shown when you made the key, such as https://your-rpg-tools-site/api/bridge.
RPGTB.Key.Name: Bridge key
RPGTB.Key.Hint: The rpgb_ key from AI & GitHub › Other tables in the Encyclopedia. Kept in this browser only, so players never get it.
RPGTB.Who.Name: Characters to bring in
RPGTB.Who.Hint: Player characters and companions, or every character the campaign can see.
RPGTB.Rolls.Name: Send rolls to RPG Tools
RPGTB.Rolls.Hint: Public rolls in chat go to the campaign's Discord rolls channel. Whispered and blind rolls never do.
